verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name.

verses.he: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
verses.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits;

verses.he: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־עֲו‍ֹנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; Who healeth all Thy diseases;

verses.he: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.en: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; Who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.he: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; So that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

verses.he: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
verses.en: The LORD executeth righteousness, And acts of justice for all that are oppressed.

verses.he: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃
verses.en: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

verses.he: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־חָֽסֶד׃
verses.en: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.he: לֹֽא־לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: He will not always contend; Neither will He keep His anger for ever.

verses.he: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲו‍ֹנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor requited us according to our iniquities.

verses.he: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.

verses.he: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath He removed our transgressions from us.

verses.he: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.en: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, So hath the LORD compassion upon them that fear Him. .

verses.he: כִּי־ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.en: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

verses.he: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃
verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof knoweth it no more.

verses.he: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה׀ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ע֭וֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃
verses.en: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, And His righteousness unto children's children;

verses.he: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: To such as keep His covenant, And to those that remember His precepts to do them.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃
verses.en: The LORD hath established His throne in the heavens; And His kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Bless the LORD, ye angels of His, Ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, Hearkening unto the voice of His word.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Bless the LORD, all ye His hosts; Ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה׀ כָּֽל־מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Bless the LORD, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul.
